title: GeoDSSOP: Geometry-aware prediction of protein backbone order parameters from sequence and structure
abstractExcerpt: Backbone amide order parameters (S2) describe protein motions on the picosecond-to-nanosecond time scale at residue resolution. GeoDSSOP combines frozen ESM-2 residue embeddings with a geometric vector perceptron-style encoder of a residue graph.

abstractExcerpt: Large-scale prioritization of protein–ligand interactions requires dynamic information at screening scale. In a conditional six-target retrospective benchmark of 88 active and 702 inactive compounds, MD-score achieved pose-aware ROC-AUC of 0.868 at top ten poses, while sampling analyses indicated that broad pose and velocity sampling was more useful than extending a small number of trajectories.

abstractExcerpt: Scientists often seek to draw causal inferences from structured data that is not independently and identically distributed, such as spatial data, network data, or molecular data.
